Heard Sri Vinay Kumar Singh, the learned counsel for the applicant and Sri Sanjay Srivastava, the learned A.G.A. for the State and perused the record.

The instant application has been filed seeking bail for the applicant in Case Crime no. 467 of 2022,
under Section 376, 323, 504, 506 I.P.C., registered at Police Station Kotwali Jaidpur, District Barabanki.
The aforesaid case has been registered on the basis of F.I.R. lodged on 06.10.2022 alleging that at about 9:10 P.M. on 05.10.2022, the applicant caught hold of the informant, dragged her, torn away her clothes and raped her.

The informant's sister-in-law and brother-in-law reached on the spot,
whereupon a scuffle took place and the applicant ran away after threatening them.
The victim has reiterated the F.I.R. version in her statement under Section 161 Cr.P.C., but the allegation of tearing of her clothes was not made by her.

In the affidavit filed in support of the bail application, it has been stated that the applicant is innocent, he has been falsely implicated in the present case and he has no criminal history.
It has been further been stated that a supplementary affidavit has been filed on behalf of the applicant stating that the applicant is suffering from Hypertension, Heart disease and Diabetes.
By means of an order dated 02.03.2023, this Court had called for the medical examination report of the applicant from the Superintended of Jail, Barabanki.

In compliance of the aforesaid order, a report has been submitted indicating that the applicant has been examined by a medical board consisting of seven doctors and they have opined that the applicant is the Hepatitis-B positive suffering from Type 2 Diabetes with Cardiomegally and Dyslipideimia along with refractory errors and he has been advised to be referred to a higher center that is K.G.M.U., Lucknow, Department of Cardiology and Gastro Medicine for further evolution and management.

entities.text: Department of Cardiology and Gastro Medicine
entities.label: ORG

sentences.text: Having considered the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and keeping in view the fact that prima facie allegations levelled by the informant are not supported by the medico legal examination report of the informant and also that the application is not keeping well and he has been referred for his treatment to a higher medical center, I am of the view that thee applicant is entitled to be released on bail.
Accordingly, this bail application stands allowed.

In case of breach of any of the above conditions, the prosecution shall be at liberty to move bail cancellation application before this Court.
.

(Subhash Vidyarthi,J.) Order Date :- 23.3.2023 Preeti.
